messages:
alex_choi: Heads up — q4b (int4) we rolled into dedicated is spiking failures on the longform summarization promptset. Canary eval shows ~12% ROUGE-L drop vs fp16 for >1k token inputs. anyone else seeing this?

jia_wang: Which subset? the 'meeting-notes' longtails or the news+blogs?

alex_choi: Mostly meeting-notes and user-submitted longthreads. Short templates look fine. failures are weird truncation / repetition artifacts.

samir_khan: Can you paste a diff of outputs? maybe kv-cache gets messed up with quant kernels.

alex_choi: pasted a couple samples below. notice extra repeated paragraph after token ~900. not consistent but hits ~2–3% of samples in the canary.

```
-- gold (fp16):
Summary: Action items: 1) ...
-- q4b output: 
Summary: Action items: 1) ... 1) ... 1) ... 1) ...
```

katie_ops: labeler throughput will take a hit if we expand golden set. how many new golds are we thinking?

emily_eval: We should isolate whether it's quantization or runtime kernel selection. quick plan: (1) repro with local quantized run on same model checkpoint (2) run an eval with quantized kernels forced-off (fallback to software) (3) expand a small golden set for targeted longform cases.

jia_wang: For (1) I can run q4b locally on a subset. need a seed list. alex can you drop 100 failing thread ids?

alex_choi: Dropped 100 ids to /tmp/q4b-longfail-100.txt on the canary node. command i used: `./eval_harness --model q4b-dedicated --inputs /tmp/q4b-longfail-100.txt --out /tmp/q4b-longfail-out.json`

samir_khan: If it's kv-cache overflow due to int4 packing, we might see nondeterministic repeats. I'll try forcing the runtime flag `--kv-cache-check` and `--disable-quant-kernel`.

katie_ops: For golden expansion: propose we add 250 longform cases (>=800 tokens) stratified across meeting-notes, tech-threads, and customer-support logs. labelers to mark: quality, hallucination flag, repeated-paragraph marker, and preferred truncation point. estimated labeling time ~8-12 min / sample.

emily_eval: Target inter-annotator agreement >=0.85 for the new golds. we'll run a 30-sample overlap to measure.

labeler-bot: New job request: create 'q4b-longform-golden-250' with tags [longform, q4b-canary, hallucination]. ETA: pending ops.

katie_ops: I'll create the job. tagging guideline draft? alex can you write a 6-bullet guideline for what counts as repetition vs acceptable paraphrase?

alex_choi: Sure. draft: 1) exact repeated sentences => mark repetition; 2) near-duplicate paraphrase repeated multiple times => mark repetition if it alters meaning; 3) benign restatement once => no mark; 4) hallucinated facts not in source => hallucination flag; 5) summary missing a major action item => quality_fail; 6) timestamp/PII redaction note optional.

jia_wang: Meanwhile I'll run the local repro and post logs. if the failure reproduces without runtime quant kernels, then it's probably model-level degradation from quantization.

samir_khan: If it's model-level, we should rollback q4b on dedicated or route longform traffic to fp16 until we have a fix. canary SLA for this test: 48 hours.

ops-deploy-bot: Canary: q4b-dedicated route metrics: last 1h error-rate +1.9% ; p50 latency +12ms.

katie_ops: Ok plan: (A) jiang run local repro by EOD; (B) label job up by tomorrow morning for 250 golds; (C) emily/qa run 30-overlap IAA after 50 labeled; (D) samir experiment with `--disable-quant-kernel` and share diff. If model-level confirmed, we'll route longform to fp16 canary policy and open rollback PR.

emily_eval: Also add an eval that compares logits/entropy for fp16 vs q4b on the same seeds — could flag token-level instability.

alex_choi: thanks all. i'll start the guideline doc and post the anchor sample list here in the thread when ready. tagging @katie_ops @jia_wang for next steps. :thumbsup:

katie_ops: 👍 putting timebox at 72h for initial triage. will update the ticket.
